finalText:
This rename is **big but safe** outside three spots.

1082 hits across 94 files. Mostly service and repo code.

Three places must keep `account_id`.

| Location | Why |
|---|---|
| [`vendor/reporting-sdk/`](vendor/reporting-sdk/src/schema.js:3) | vendored, generated — do not edit |
| [`lib/serialize.js:8`](lib/serialize.js:8), `docs/openapi.yaml` | public API field, frozen by contract |
| [`migrations/20250114_create_accounts.sql:3`](migrations/20250114_create_accounts.sql:3) | already applied in prod, editing doesn't rename the live column |

Everywhere else it's internal, safe to rename.

Next, rename the internals only. Add a fresh migration for the DB column. Leave the wire name alone.
